entries.name: Khao Jaan-Prod (ข้าวจานโปรด)
entries.description: New casual Thai brand from the team behind Michelin-starred Khao, opened July 2026 on CentralWorld's 7th floor with a glass-house dining room.

entries.name: ThaiCoon
entries.description: "Real Thai. No Rules" — new venture from Buddy Hatayadom with Chef Wai of Chiang Mai's Rasik, now in soft opening beside Pullman Hotel G.

entries.name: Jakawaan
entries.description: Traditional Thai dining by food designer Nick Pitthayanot, reviving hard-to-find heritage dishes; set menu or a la carte, booking advised.

entries.name: TAANG — Caravan, Table & Wine
entries.description: 12-seat Northern Thai chef's table from Chef Kong Chaiwongkajorn with a wine-led beverage program, Mon-Wed seatings.

entries.name: Luke Bangkok
entries.description: Two-floor Italian all-day diner in a revamped colonial-style shophouse — homemade pizza, hot sandwiches, retro red interiors.

entries.name: Curry Up
entries.description: First Thai outpost of NIGO's Japanese curry brand, opened alongside the HUMAN MADE store on Central Embassy's second level.

entries.name: Folk Lane
entries.description: Community brunch cafe in the former Toby's space — coffee, sandwiches, breakfast plates plus salmon miso ochazuke.

entries.name: CULT EVERYDAY
entries.description: Wellness cafe built on no-sugar no-ice smoothies, wraps and daily-nutrition bowls with playful branding.

entries.name: OBi Record Bar
entries.description: Vinyl listening bar near BTS Sala Daeng where records shape the room's mood.

entries.name: House of Savoy
entries.description: Cafe dansant from the BACCARAT / UPPER HOUSE / 24 BLVD team on the second floor of SILQ Hotel & Residence.

entries.name: Baan Phraya (reopening)
entries.description: Mandarin Oriental's landmark Thai restaurant reopened with a refreshed royal/regional Thai concept under Chef Pom Phatchara.

trend_note: Thai heritage is the theme of the month: new brands from Michelin-starred Thai teams (Khao Jaan-Prod, Baan Phraya, TAANG, Jakawaan) doubling down on royal/regional Thai, while cafe growth skews wellness and brunch.
